import hashlib, json, time
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from transformers.integrations import flex_attention as flex
from transformers import masking_utils as masks
torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
torch.set_num_threads(2)
torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
torch.manual_seed(20260907)
sources={name:hashlib.sha256(Path(source.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name,source in (("flex",flex),("masking",masks))}
assert sources=={"flex":"46655f4b8b528a75cdaa418e2fc6690fa4c2dd5e0180fe78900f4db0a7c83650","masking":"c159cd91c2a7fcafce04a8b6cbca55c320ce904b8ebf634383c97da5d9313ce3"}
print(json.dumps({"event":"identity","source_sha256":sources,"torch":torch.__version__}),flush=True)
with torch.no_grad():
    length=129
    query=torch.randn(8,32,length,128,device="cuda",dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    key=torch.randn(8,8,length,128,device="cuda",dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    value=torch.randn_like(key)
    mask=torch.ones(8,length,device="cuda",dtype=torch.bool)
    for index in range(8):
        mask[index,:index]=False
        if index%2==0:
            mask[index,-index-1:]=False

    from types import SimpleNamespace
    module=SimpleNamespace(num_key_value_groups=4,is_causal=True,training=False)
    input_hashes={name:hashlib.sha256(tensor.contiguous().view(torch.uint8).cpu().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest() for name,tensor in (("query",query),("key",key),("value",value),("mask",mask))}
    assert input_hashes=={"query":"b1cf6283eba0c16132208c2890f84b2e3e26ab5ebe3e8cc9afcf996e51a8d889","key":"3868602dc9103efa182ef6fa738541ca6d3d370760ff422258ccd1a24328aa17","value":"def1a17a53373dc379f5184c7aef770ca19ccd2ce71582fc86c3189b72bc7b45","mask":"06cd4508b7bc4fa9ae5bb0806cc7f34fb22f373631ab7251625a0f1dcb5f47f7"}
    assert torch.get_float32_matmul_precision()=="highest"
    ids=torch.arange(length,device="cuda")
    keep=(ids[None,:,None]>=ids[None,None,:]) & mask[:,None,:]
    scores=torch.einsum("bghqd,bgkd->bghqk",query.reshape(8,8,4,length,128).double(),key.double())*128**-0.5
    scores.masked_fill_(~keep[:,None,None,:,:],-torch.inf)
    valid=keep.any(-1)
    weights=torch.where(valid[:,None,None,:,None],scores.softmax(-1),torch.zeros_like(scores))
    oracle=torch.einsum("bghqk,bgkd->bghqd",weights,value.double()).reshape(8,32,length,128).transpose(1,2)
    print(json.dumps({"event":"paired_input","sha256":input_hashes,"fully_masked_queries":int((~valid).sum())}),flush=True)
    for name in ("flex_fp32_ieee_cast_bfloat16",):
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        tick=time.perf_counter()
        block=masks.flex_attention_mask(8,length,length,attention_mask=mask,device="cuda")
        output=flex.flex_attention_forward(module,query.float(),key.float(),value.float(),block,scaling=128**-0.5)[0].to(query.dtype)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        seconds=time.perf_counter()-tick
        error=None
        try:
            torch.testing.assert_close(output.double(),oracle,rtol=0.005,atol=0.0005)
        except AssertionError as failure:
            error=str(failure)
        difference=(output.double()-oracle).abs()
        violates=difference>(0.0005+0.005*oracle.abs())
        row={"event":"precision_control","implementation":name,"oracle_error":error,"mismatched_elements":int(violates.sum()),"total_elements":output.numel(),"max_abs_fp64_error":float(difference.max()),"all_finite":bool(torch.isfinite(output).all()),"fully_masked_output_exact_zero":bool(torch.all(output[~valid]==0)),"cold_call_seconds":seconds,"output_dtype":str(output.dtype)}
        print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
print(json.dumps({"event":"complete","cells":1,"model_outcomes":0,"old_flex_failure_overridden":False}),flush=True)
